newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on profit taking.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed sharply down on Wednesday as investors booked profit after a week-long rally, brokers said.

The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index lost 74.46 points or 6.64 percent at 1,045.41 on a turnover of 39.9 million taka. Of 124 traded issues, 113 lost, 10 gained and one remained unchanged.
"Index lost basically because of profit taking. A large number of scrips rose significantly in the past week which tempted investors to book profit," said one broker.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co Ltd lost 14.93 taka to 136 and Chittagong Cement shed 170.29 to 1,534.
